name: Gmail

notes.text: Composio's shared app lets your own Workspace users connect today, but whether its Google verification covers the read scopes you need is not stated in Composio's docs: confirm before relying on it. An internal app of your own needs no Google verification.
Composio's shared Google app works for your own Workspace users; an internal app of your own needs no Google verification either.

Composio's shared app lets you start today, and managed auth configs accept scope overrides. Whether its Google verification covers the read scopes you need is not stated in Composio's docs — confirm before launch. Your own app needs restricted-scope verification below.
Composio's shared app lets you start today; users see Composio on the consent screen. Your own branded app needs sensitive-scope verification below.

summary: Sending mail needs Google's sensitive-scope check (days to two weeks); reading mail needs restricted-scope verification plus an annual security assessment (weeks to months). Internal Workspace apps skip both.

toggles.label: What does your app do with Gmail?

gates.title: Create a Google Cloud project and OAuth client

blockers.symptom: Users beyond the 100th are refused on an unverified app
blockers.fix: Finish verification before launch; the cap cannot be reset.

gates.nextStep: In Google Cloud console: create a project, enable the Gmail API, fill in Google Auth Platform → Branding, then create an OAuth client (Web application) with the redirect URI https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback. Add yourself as a test user.

gates.title: Brand verification

blockers.fix: Make the homepage and privacy policy match the app name on the consent screen, on a domain you own.

gates.nextStep: In Google Auth Platform → Verification Center, submit for verification once branding, homepage and privacy policy are live.
gates.whatToAsk: Ask Google's verification team, in your verification email thread: "What is the current brand verification turnaround for my project?"

gates.title: Sensitive scope verification (gmail.send)

blockers.symptom: Google asks for more scope justification
blockers.fix: Reply with a demo video and a specific explanation for each scope.

gates.nextStep: In Verification Center, submit the gmail.send justification and demo video, then reply to Google's emails promptly.

gates.title: Restricted scope verification (read scopes)

blockers.fix: Start CASA and the demo video on day 1. Google says this might require several months; 30 working days is a floor.

gates.nextStep: In Verification Center, submit the restricted-scope justification and demo video; start the CASA assessment in parallel.

gates.title: CASA security assessment

blockers.fix: Get quotes from an empanelled assessor.

gates.nextStep: Pick an assessor from Google's CASA list and book the assessment.
gates.whatToAsk: Ask two CASA assessors for a quote: "What is your current lead time and price for a Tier 2 assessment of a web app?"

requirements.label: Own domain with a homepage that loads over HTTPS
howToGet: Publish a homepage describing the app

requirements.label: Privacy policy on your domain
howToGet: Publish a privacy policy that covers Google user data, linked from the homepage

requirements.label: Limited Use disclosure in the privacy policy
howToGet: Add Google's Limited Use statement to your privacy policy; the exact sentence is ready to copy.

requirements.label: Support email on your domain
howToGet: Publish a support address on your own domain (for example support@yourapp.com) on your homepage or contact page.

requirements.label: CASA Letter of Validation
howToGet: Complete the assessment and remediate findings
requirements.whatToAsk: Ask your CASA assessor how long until the Letter of Validation is issued after testing starts.

requirements.label: Demo video of the OAuth flow and scope use
howToGet: Record the consent screen and each scope being used in the app

claims.text: gmail.send is Sensitive; gmail.readonly, gmail.modify, gmail.compose, gmail.metadata and mail.google.com/ are Restricted.
Brand verification is reported to take 2–3 business days; source not captured.
claims.note: The research agent tagged this official but did not record which Google page.

claims.text: Sensitive scope verification takes 10 business days.
claims.note: Another Google page reportedly says 3–5 business days (URL not captured).

claims.text: Restricted scope verification takes about 6 weeks and might require several months.
The CASA security assessment is required when restricted data passes a third-party server; empanelled assessor, AL1/AL2, annual full re-test.

sources.quote: CASA: required when restricted data passes a third-party server; empanelled assessor; AL1/AL2; annual full re-test.

claims.text: Google does not publish the CASA cost.
claims.note: Vendor estimates exist, but no source URL was captured, so no number is shown.

claims.text: Unverified apps are limited to 100 new users for their lifetime, and the cap cannot be reset.

sources.quote: Unverified apps: 100 new users lifetime, cannot be reset.
